text:
alex: FYI customer NordicTech (acct:nordic-42) — invoice 2026-NT-042 is on HOLD. They submitted a resale cert and claim reverse-charge applies, but billing rejects because PO number and VAT validation failed. Can billing triage?

maria: on it. I see invoice metadata: PO=98843 but customer submitted PO=98-843. Small formatting mismatch causing our PO strict-match rule to fail. Also VIES check returned a country mismatch for the VAT ID.

jonas: digging into the validation logs — VIES returned COUNTRY_MISMATCH for VAT="NL123456789B01" when invoice.country="DE". The customer says they operate through a NL branch but billing profile is still DE.

kira: possible root causes: 1) customer billing_country is stale; 2) our VIES normalizer strips spaces but not hyphens; 3) we cache negative VIES results for 24h. If the customer corrected their VAT in a different system we might be hitting cache.

alex: maria — can you reproduce and, if needed, temporarily mark invoice exempt to avoid collection? Customer is blocked by procurement.

maria: I can manually mark exempt once we confirm documentation. Repro steps I used:
```
# repro against staging
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/invoices/2026-NT-042/validate_vat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_KEY" \
  -d '{"vat_id":"NL123456789B01"}'
```
Response:
```
{"error":"vat_validation_failed","vies_status":"COUNTRY_MISMATCH","code":422}
```
The resale_cert PDF is attached to the customer record but /apply_exemption returns 409 if PO mismatch and 422 if VIES fails.

jonas: exact sequence that hits the bug: 1) create customer with country=DE 2) add vat_id=NL123456789B01 3) upload resale cert 4) create invoice with country=DE + PO=98843 5) call apply_exemption -> we validate VAT against VIES, hit COUNTRY_MISMATCH because branch country != invoice country, then we short-circuit PO fuzzy-match and return hold.

maria: note: procurement wants invoice to include reverse-charge note immediately so they can submit to PO system. If we hold it, payment delayed. Can we accept PO variants? i.e. normalize hyphens/spaces and compare numeric only.

kira: quick patch: change PO matcher to numeric-only compare and relax country check for resale certs where uploaded doc explicitly states cross-border branch. Also will add a cache-invalidate endpoint: POST /admin/vat/revalidate/{customer_id}. I’ll PR and target EOD.

billing-bot: created ticket BILL-13472 and escalated to billing-ops. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-13472

maria: I manually unblocked invoice 2026-NT-042 and set note: "Temporary exemption granted pending VIES normalization; refund if tax later determined owed." Customer invoiced to NordicTech / PO 98-843 (matched to 98843 after normalization).

alex: Thanks — can someone add the exact admin repro steps to the playbook so support can follow without engineering? We need: (a) how to run revalidate, (b) how to normalize PO, (c) checklist for granting a manual exemption when docs exist.

jonas: adding steps here in thread: 1) verify resale_cert PDF includes company + branch country; 2) run POST /admin/vat/revalidate/{customer_id} 3) if VIES still fails, accept manual exemption and add audit note with uploaded doc ID 4) normalize PO in invoice JSON and mark applied_exemption=true 5) notify sales & procurement.

kira: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/812 — implements numeric PO compare + admin revalidate endpoint + cache TTL override for single customer. ETA reviewer feedback in ~3h.

maria: I'll follow up with NordicTech to confirm they see the invoice updated and to get formal confirmation from their procurement.

alex: great. Please ping here when billing ticket is resolved so I can close the support case. :thumbsup:
